_comment: 内容协商那篇的标准归因依据。用来纠正「并列时按书写顺序」那个说法。
title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics, §12.5.1 Accept

revisions.evidence: Media ranges can be overridden by more specific media ranges or specific media types. If more than one media range applies to a given type, the most specific reference has precedence.
revisions.note: 规范按**具体程度**排优先级；对 q 值相同的两个类型只说它们是 equally preferred，**没有规定按书写顺序**。「并列靠前优先」是本项目的选择。
